sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject: both SHACL-SPARQL constraints invert validation logic. In the known branch, the query selects the ship when a non-unknown curve type and a valid reified correspondence are present, thereby reporting a violation for a valid case; in the unknown branch, it selects the ship precisely when the curve type is unknown, thereby rejecting the required unknown alternative. Rewrite the queries so they return rows only for violations: the known branch must be applicable only when stressLifeCurveType is present and not unknown and must report missing or incorrectly tied selection/material/evidence correspondence; the unknown branch must be applicable only when stressLifeCurveType is present and equals unknown and must report any failure to select twoSlopeStressLifeCurve.
